remarks: City lifestyle at its best! Located in the heart of downtown Stamford, just minutes to shopping, parks, beaches, popular restaurants and Metro North Train Station. The Classic offers a walkable city life with outstanding amenities that include 24/7 concierge, a glass enclosed rooftop pool overlooking the city, a "state of the art" fitness center and a newly renovated common area for entertaining and relaxing. In addition, there is a pet friendly green "park" off the 3rd floor, along with an area set up with outdoor grills for summer dining. This spacious 1 BR unit is the largest one bedroom floor plan in the building with two full bathrooms, and panoramic views of the city from the walls of windows. The open floor plan living area is perfect for a full sectional, a dining space, and a cozy corner for an office desk. Glass sliders lead to the private balcony, providing an additional outdoor space. The unit features all hardwood floors in a rich walnut color, stainless steel appliances and sleek black granite countertops in the kitchen, an updated ensuite bathroom/bedroom, and multiple closets with built-ins for storage. One deeded parking spot in the building garage is included. One hour from Stamford Metro North to Grand Central.
